scripts.build: parcel build src/index.html --dist-dir ./public && cp -r src/img ./public/ && find ./public -maxdepth 1 -name '*.css' -not -name 'index.css' | head -1 | xargs -I{} cp {} ./public/index.css
scripts.build:gh-pages: parcel build src/index.html --dist-dir ./public --public-url /kanadev00/ && cp -r src/img ./public/ && find ./public -maxdepth 1 -name '*.js' -exec sed -i.bak 's|"/img/|"/kanadev00/img/|g' {} \; && find ./public -name '*.bak' -delete && find ./public -maxdepth 1 -name '*.css' -not -name 'index.css' | head -1 | xargs -I{} cp {} ./public/index.css
